clips.title: The story
paras: Stolen Enchanting Supplies is an errand undertaken near the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. An apprentice named Blixie Fitzwink lost a shipment of magical reagents during a gnoll ambush, and adventurers must retrieve the stolen goods from camps around Stone Cairn Lake. Recovering the materials spares the apprentice severe chore duty and keeps Master Theocritus's arcane studies supplied.

A routine supply run turns perilous when Blixie Fitzwink, an apprentice assisting Master Theocritus, is ambushed by hostile gnolls between the trading post and the Tower of Azora. Fleeing for her life, she drops her cargo, leaving valuable enchanting reagents scattered among the gnoll camps dotting the shores of Stone Cairn Lake. Desperate to avoid weeks of disciplinary cleanup duty following arcane polymorph experiments, she appeals to passing adventurers to recover the missing goods.

The Tower of Azora serves as an arcane bastion in eastern Elwynn Forest, where Master Theocritus conducts sensitive magical research. Sourcing delicate reagents requires regular traffic with local trading posts, but the rising boldness of gnoll packs around Stone Cairn Lake makes transport hazardous. Recovering the lost supplies ensures that Theocritus's studies continue uninterrupted while keeping his beleaguered assistant out of trouble.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!
I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!
